in_marathi.name: Chandala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Chandala is a name given to the maiden form of the Moon God, Chandrama. She is known for her gentle and calming presence.
